content: Background behavior (verified MDN Page Visibility API): use visibilitychange/Document.hidden to pause SSE consumption and polling when hidden and refetch on visible; rAF stops entirely in background tabs and timers are throttled (~10s Chrome), while WebSockets/SSE tabs are exempt from throttling so the app must explicitly stop work rather than rely on the browser; the dashboard-polling use case is called out verbatim by MDN. Mobile pattern: on visible, revalidate run state before showing stale data.
